reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) does not address CoCrFeNiTi, its solid-solution state, its mechanical properties, or the effect of aging on dislocation obstacles. E1 discusses general HEA thermodynamics and E2 examines grain boundary deformation in CoCrFeMnNi, leaving all key premises unsupported by specific prior evidence.
premises: As-cast equimolar CoCrFeNiTi is a homogeneous, simple solid solution with minimal lattice heterogeneity
Low lattice friction and absence of obstacles (precipitates, ordering) enable easy dislocation glide
Easy dislocation glide limits strain hardening, causing low yield strength and hardness
Aging can introduce nano-scale precipitates or short-range ordering that pin dislocations
Pinning dislocations increases work hardening, yield strength, and hardness
